text: Create ONE 390px wide mobile catalogue "02 — Tủ sách · Điện thoại". Same signature as desktop catalogue. Real mobile reflow, no horizontal overflow: compact full club name+menu, title32px, search full width, "Bộ lọc" button+active-category label, TWO book columns with readable titles and48px actions, four to six books, availability, pagination and50cuốn/trang. Header menu opens6sections instead of squeezing6navlabels. Bottom navigation4destinations Tủ sách / Đơn của tôi / Hoạt động / Thêm. Use2px paper offset buttons, catalogue divider tab active state. Show small footer Bản concept • Nội dung minh họa. Do not show statusbarfakeiphoneframe.

Create ONE 1440px desktop book detail/reservation "03 — Chi tiết & giữ chỗ · PC". Unified hub navigation. A large paper bookplate left with simple typographic cover "Dế Mèn phiêu lưu ký — Tô Hoài", availability Còn sách and3short summary paragraphs. Right column "Phiếu giữ chỗ" akin beautifully ruled librarycard with explicitly labeled name, telephone, pickup session selector Tuesday/Thursday sample options, small CAPTCHA placeholder "Xác minh bảo mật", consent/info that this reserves1book and bring name/phone at pickup. No emailrequired, loginrequired, cart, shipping or payonline. Deposit section clearly "Tiền cọc hoàn lại khi trả sách" illustrative amount labeled, not purchase price. Strong "Xác nhận giữ chỗ" action and quiet back link. One small note "Giữ sách đến hết buổi trực đã chọn." Inline error example useful but do not clutter. Make form practical, roomy, vintage not generic rounded panels. Footer Bản concept • Nội dung minh họa.

Create ONE 390px mobile book detail/reservation "04 — Phiếu giữ chỗ · Điện thoại". Same style and book as desktop. Compact top back/title; coverthumbnail alongside booktitle, then summary accordion "Giới thiệu cuốn sách"; one-column form full-width fields full name, phone, pickup session (Thu Ba/Thu Nam correct Vietnamese), CAPTCHA placeholder; keep1book/order no technical limits. Fixed bottom clear primary48px "Xác nhận giữ chỗ", with safe padding no coveringcontent, small refundabledeposit explanatory line if amount shown. Stacked paperreceipt look, minimal ornament. Footer Bản concept • Nội dung minh họa. No deviceframe.

Create ONE 1440px desktop internal workspace "05 — Quầy mượn–trả · PC". Same warm identity but efficient high-contrast readable workflow. Sidebar full clubname, Tổng quan, Quầy mượn–trả(active), Kho sách, Lịch trực, Thành viên, Tuyển thành viên, Sự kiện, Bài viết, Quỹ & báo cáo, Quản trị & nội dung. Top title "Sổ trực hôm nay", sampledata badge, sessionOpen with close button. Main focus barcode/title/phone search and tabs "Chờ nhận / Đang mượn / Cần xử lý". Real table 5sample rows with masked phone, booktitle, pickup/return status, deposit separate from revenue, explicit "Bàn giao sách"/"Nhận trả" actions. Right narrow today's duty note and internal unavailability alert "Bản sách cần kiểm tra — gọi bạn đọc trước khi hủy" manualaction. Modest counters with clearly minh họa, avoid giant dashboardcharts. Buttons paperpressed, rulelines, dense but comfortable. User name "Quản lý mẫu", no real personaldata. Do not add financial-transfer action. Footer Bản concept • Nội dung minh họa.

Create ONE 390px mobile internal desk "06 — Sổ trực · Điện thoại". Real mobile adaptation of Quầy mượn–trả: compact full clubname+menu, title Sổ trực hôm nay, sampledata label, searchbarcode/phone and scanicon as conceptonly. Segmented2tabs Chờ nhận / Đang mượn and overflow for Cần xử lý. Replace table by3stacked loan slips/cards, bookname, maskedreaderphone, statusword, refundabledeposit on distinct row, large48px "Bàn giao sách" or "Nhận trả". One softterracotta internal alert aboutunavailablecopy. Bottomnav Quầy / Kho sách / Lịch trực / Thêm. No squeezedtable. No fakeavatarpeople. Palette locked, legible16px text, librarycard vintage treatment. Footer Bản concept • Nội dung minh họa.

Create ONE 1440px desktop public activities page "07 — Bản tin câu lạc bộ · PC", SAME unified hub navigation active Lịch trực & sự kiện. A literary student newspaper layout: editorial masthead "Những cuộc hẹn bên trang sách", mainlarge event feature "Đêm Sách" with a neutral labeled photoplaceholder "Ảnh hoạt động CLB" (no invented peoplephotos), two small stories Sinh hoạt hằng tuần and Ngày Sách Việt Nam. Rightside dutycalendar card Tuesday/Thursday, upcoming break notice clearly illustrative. Bottomcolumns Góc review excerpt and Tuyển thành viên notice. Catalogentry persistent. Fine double-rule dividers, date tickets, asymmetrical columns. Only6existing hubtabs, not separate apps. No fabricated official awards/statistics/realupcomingdates. Footer Bản concept • Nội dung minh họa.

Create ONE 1440px tall design-system specimen "08 — Bộ UI & trạng thái". This is an actual component board for this specificwebsite, NOT marketing landingpage. Top title Thư viện ký ức and full brand, palette swatches with EXACTHEXlabels. Typography Newsreader+BeVietnamPro, Vietnamese headline and paragraph "Mở sách, đọc tương lai. Những cuốn sách, những người bạn." Demonstrate buttons normal/hover/pressed/focus/disabled/loading, secondary/ghost/destructive; catalogue foldertabs; pagination; searchandfilter; select/text input with helpful/errorstates; checkbox;3availability status badges with text; librarybookcard; loanreceiptrow; warningnotice/toast; confirmdialog;3shadowlevels flat/stackedpaper/overlay with CSSannotations. 48px hitareas. Show desktop/sidebar and mobilebottomnav miniatures. Do not autochange anypalette, no purpleblue. Goodscannable grid, subtle vintage lines, never microscopiclabels. Alternative fontpair comparison small Lora+BeVietnamPro versus recommended Newsreader+BeVietnamPro. This screen should explain tactilebuttonstates and paperdepth clearly.
